name: Consolidated Server Data Pipeline
description: Maps the CHARESS Consolidé consolidated_db to FHIR with SQLMesh and routes it through OpenHIM — Patient identities to OpenCR, clinical to the SHR. SYNC mode (default): Consolidé is read-only, so a local pipeline-db holds a synced copy and SQLMesh transforms there (CONSOLIDATED_* = read-only user). DIRECT mode (docker-compose.direct.yml): SQLMesh runs on Consolidé directly, no copy (needs write access). PIPELINE_IMAGE defaults to the GHCR package; set it to sedish-fhir-pipeline:local to build locally.
